verdict.rationale: Twilio's own MCP docs say its MCP server 'indexes public API specifications' covering 1,800+ endpoints. That implies first-party, machine-readable specs are published, but the evidence never shows a downloadable OpenAPI file or where to get it. The llms.txt and docs.md probes are LLM-friendly documentation formats, not API specs, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec, its location or format details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it can be downloaded and used.
